# ExitCode0

> Homelab, self-hosting, Home Assistant and local AI how-tos by Tom Cocking, each one tested on his own hardware before it is published. UK-based.

Every post has a Markdown version at the same URL with `index.md` appended, for example https://exitcode0.net/posts/proxmox-ollama-lxc-nvidia-gpu-passthrough/index.md. Posts end with a block you can paste into a coding agent.

Author: https://exitcode0.net/about/
Site card: https://exitcode0.net/images/exitcode0-card.jpg

## Posts
- [Sonoff ZBMINIL2 Wiring Guide: No Neutral, Keep the Existing Wall Switch](https://exitcode0.net/posts/sonoff-zbminil2-wiring-guide/index.md): Wire a Sonoff ZBMINIL2 with no neutral and keep the existing wall switch: terminals, the sleeved blue wire, pairing with Home Assistant and what to check first.
- [How to Expand an Ubuntu LVM Logical Volume to Use All Free Space on the PV](https://exitcode0.net/posts/how-to-expand-an-lvm-lv-to-use-all-space-on-the-pv/index.md): Expand an Ubuntu LVM logical volume to use all free space on the physical volume with lvextend and resize2fs, when the root partition fills up.
- [Running Ollama in a Proxmox LXC with NVIDIA GPU Passthrough](https://exitcode0.net/posts/proxmox-ollama-lxc-nvidia-gpu-passthrough/index.md): Set up Ollama in a Proxmox LXC with NVIDIA GPU passthrough, Tailscale access and Open WebUI. Run local LLMs with GPU acceleration on your own hardware.
- [Adding WMIC command to the Windows path](https://exitcode0.net/posts/adding-wmic-command-to-the-windows-path/index.md): Add C:\Windows\System32\wbem to the Windows PATH to restore wmic and fix 'wmic is not recognized' errors on Windows 10 after updates or PATH changes.
- [Powershell - Checking the Language Mode](https://exitcode0.net/posts/powershell-checking-the-language-mode/index.md): Check the PowerShell language mode on Windows to spot ConstrainedLanguage restrictions before running administrative or automation scripts.

- [Debian 9 - How to upgrade python 3.5 to python 3.7](https://exitcode0.net/posts/debian-9-how-to-upgrade-python-3-5-to-python-3-7/index.md): Install Python 3.7 on Debian 9 from source and make it the default in place of 3.5 with update-alternatives, plus the pip fixes afterwards.
- [Debian 9 - Running a python script at boot](https://exitcode0.net/posts/debian-9-running-a-python-script-at-startup/index.md): Run a Python script automatically at boot on Debian with crontab @reboot, pass parameters, redirect output and check it started with journalctl.
- [Double NAT port forwarding with a Fortigate](https://exitcode0.net/posts/double-nat-port-forwarding-with-a-fortigate/index.md): Set up Fortigate VIP port forwarding through a double NAT, routing external traffic via a DMZ IP through nested gateways to reach services like Plex.
